diagnosis engine emits primary/secondary/data_quality_issue

six observation lenses single chart default composite
overlay max two lines; hook/payoff paired no third
beat auxiliary nodes excluded from main polyline
valence domain -100..100
diagnosis band primary/secondary
legacy uncalibrated banner
